goal: Allow node operators on multi-homed machines to choose the local source address for outbound connections
Avoids relying on the operating system routing table to pick the outbound network interface
agreement: Strong support for adding a separate option rather than changing existing bind semantics (vasild)
Approach approval with interest in alternative option naming (winterrdog)
Past objections to overloading bind were resolved by using a dedicated option (luke-jr, gmaxwell)

categories.name: p2p
why: P3 because multi-homed node operators gain control over their outbound IP selection
Solves a long-standing configuration request for specialized setups while remaining deferrable
